_how: Written from treatment.md (crew sign-off). Screens are labelled demo placeholders (materials README). Build with make_film.py.
name: quartile-film

brand.name: Quartile
brand.positioningZh: 给临床研究者的桌面统计工具
motto: The reviewer asks how. The script answers.

scenes._why: Hook: the survival curve fills the frame, still, while a question is asked. A real chart from the product, not a logo.

say.en: A reviewer asks how you got that curve.
say.zh: 审稿人问：这条曲线是怎么来的？

points.zh: 森林图与 Meta 分析

say.en: It runs on your own Mac or Windows PC, and your data never leaves it.
say.zh: 在你自己的 Mac 或 Windows 电脑上运行，数据不离开电脑。

say.en: The AUC comes with its 95% confidence interval, on the figure you would publish.
say.zh: AUC 附带 95% 置信区间，就是你会发表的那张图。

scenes._shape: a screen feature recast as a zoomed detail, so two proof beats do not share a shape

scenes.zh: 审稿人要的，是能重跑的过程。
scenes.en: Reviewers want a process they can rerun.

title.zh: 两种方式合并的荟萃分析

say.en: Forest plots with fixed and random effects, and I² for heterogeneity.
say.zh: 固定与随机效应的森林图，并附 I² 异质性。

title.zh: 每个结果都可导出为 R 脚本
title.en: Every result exports as an R script

say.en: Every result exports as an R script a reviewer can run.
say.zh: 每个结果都可导出为 R 脚本，审稿人可以重跑。

title.zh: 手机上查看已保存的分析

say.en: A phone companion lists your saved analyses.
say.zh: 手机伴侣列出你所有已保存的分析。

scenes._hero: the hook's curve returns and resolves out of the UI as the finished figure (callback to the cover)

say.en: The reviewer asks how. The script answers.
say.zh: 审稿人问怎么来的，脚本给出答案。
